description_sq:
Apartamenti shitet nga agjensia (pranohen bashkepunimet)
Apartamenti i tipologjise 3+1+2 ndodhet ne nje objekt te vitit 2010 me ashensor i pozicionuar buze bulevardit te Lanes, perballe kompleksit Delijorgji.
Ka nje planimetri perfekte, me dy ballkone, dy tualete dhe garderobe ne dhomen matrimoniale. Apartamenti eshte i investuar me rifinitura cilesore, termoizolim te brendshem, etj. dhe shitet i mobiluar si ne foto.
Prona disponon dhe 3 poste parkimi ne katin -1 te objektit, te mbyllur dhe investuar.
Apartamenti disponon certifikate pronesie.
title_en: Apartment 3+1+2 for sale in front of Delijorgji
description_en: The apartment is sold by the agency (cooperations are accepted) The 3+1+2 typology apartment is located in a 2010 building with an elevator, located on the edge of Lanes boulevard, in front of the Delijorgji complex. It has a perfect layout, with two balconies, two toilets and a wardrobe in the master bedroom. The apartment is invested with quality refinishing, internal thermal insulation, etc. and sold furnished as in the photo. The property also has 3 parking spaces on the 1st floor of the building, closed and invested. The apartment has ownership certificates.
